JBSA-Lackland, TX, 78236 Registration Instructions: Please RSVP by notifying the individuals below and attaching the base pass access form by 10 Jul 2026. For the base pass access form, please fill out the boxes in Section IV only. This location is on military installation and base access for every attendee is mandatory. Base access forms must be submitted on time to meet required timeline by the security office. POC: Rodney Alexander, rodney.d.alexander@usace.army.mil; Heather Groff, heather.groff@usace.army.mil Link: https://forms.osi.apps.mil/r/xj8FMrZ1mm Project Overview Project Title: Multi-Domain Cyber and Intel Operations Center Location: Joint Base San Antonio, Lackland AFB Texas Agency: Air Force NAICS Code: 236220 Type of Award: Other Transaction Agreement (OTA), Progressive Design Build (PDB), with a Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP), Part A award for Design Efforts and Part B option for Construction. Programmed Amount: $986,000,000 Project Description Construct a Multi-Domain Cyber and Intel Operations Center for the 16th Air Force. This facility will accommodate approximately 3,500 occupants. Construction will consist of a multi-story, high-performance structural steel frame on a reinforced concrete foundation, designed to meet enhanced security standards including progressive collapse resistance. The exterior will feature a professional and impressive "sense of arrival" while maximizing natural light through advanced design techniques, balanced with security and operational constraints. The integrated Visitor Control Center (VCC), physically connected to the main facility to manage access to the secure campus will serve as the main lobby and heritage hall supporting public affairs and visitor education. A significant portion of this facility will be a purpose-built Cyber Operations Data Center, engineered to support high-performance computing (HPC), AI server clusters and Machine Learning (ML) platforms. It will feature scalable, high-density power infrastructure designed for future expansion. Acquisition Strategy The USACE will use a streamlined competitive selection process: Step 1 � Request for Qualifications/White Papers: Interested parties will submit a Statement of Qualifications (max 30 pages). This initial step serves as a rapid down-select to identify a short list of the most credible and experienced Offerors. Action: A public solicitation will be posted on SAM.gov, issuing a Request for White Papers. Offerors will be required to respond with a concise, qualifications-based White Paper, not to exceed approximately 30 pages. Focus: The White Paper will demonstrate the Offeror's corporate experience with projects of similar integrated acquisition strategy, size and complexity, highlight the qualifications of key personnel, and articulate their understanding of the PDB process and the project's unique technical challenges. Timeline: The submission window will be compressed to an aggressive 15-day period to maintain procurement momentum and attract agile, responsive partners. The government intends to down-select up to three Companies to proceed to the next step. Step 2 � Pitches: Selected Companies will participate in pitch meetings. This step is the cornerstone of the evaluation, moving beyond a paper-based assessment to a direct evaluation of the team's expertise, problem-solving abilities, and collaborative chemistry. Action: After a rapid evaluation of the White Papers submission responses, the Government will invite up to three most qualified Companies to participate in mandatory, one-on-one pitch meetings. Purpose: These are not standard, one-way presentations. They are structured, interactive Q&A sessions designed to simulate the real-world working environment of a Progressive Design-Build project. The Government will engage the Company in an active dialogue to evaluate how effectively the Company and key partners communicate with the Government and with one another. Additionally, the session will test the team's agility, responsiveness, and collaborative problem-solving capabilities when presented with shifting project requirements in real time. Evaluation Criteria: This critical event allows the Government to assess the team�s true collaborative capabilities, depth of technical expertise, and overall "fit" for the PDB partnership; qualities that cannot be adequately judged from a written proposal alone. Final Selection: Most Qualified Determination and Award The selection decision will be made swiftly following the conclusion of the pitch meetings

description: Action Type: Notice of Post-Award Justification for Other Than Full and Open Competition (JOFOC) under FAR 6.103-1. Contract Number: 1332KP22CNEEP0014 Contractor: Spire Global, Inc. Modification Value: $5,000,000.00 Extended Period of Performance: October 01, 2026 � September 30, 2027 (12-Month Extension) Scope of Services: The NOAA Acquisition and Grants Office (AGO), Satellite and Information Acquisition Division (SIAD), has executed a bilateral contract modification to procure extended spaceborne data acquisition services from Spire Global, Inc. Under this modification, the contractor will collect, process, and deliver Level 1 science-grade brightness temperature data (in NetCDF format) from its operational space-based Hyperspectral Microwave Sensor (HyMS) instrument integrated on a 16U LEMUR satellite platform. This data will support the NESDIS Commercial Data Program and the Office of Systems Architecture and Engineering (SAE) in conducting a comprehensive evaluation of hyperspectral microwave technology impact on global Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) models across a full annual atmospheric cycle. Authority: This sole-source modification was executed pursuant to the statutory authority of 41 U.S.C. 3304(a)(1), as implemented by FAR 6.103-1, "Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements." Spire Global, Inc. is the only commercial source with a currently operational, space-qualified system capable of delivering the required synoptic spaceborne data within the mandated timeframe to satisfy FY26 Congressional Directives. Note: The fully executed and redacted JOFOC document detailing the rationale for this sole-source action is attached to this notice.

title: Finland – Event services – Tapahtumatekniikan palveluiden hankinta
description: Hankinnan kohteena on tapahtumatekniikan palvelut ja laitevuokraus Tampereen kaupungin järjestämissä tapahtumissa tai hallinnoimissa tiloissa ja alueilla. Tampereen kaupunki tilaa tuottamiinsa tapahtumiin tai hallinnoimiinsa tiloihin ja alueille tapahtumatekniikkaa puitejärjestelyyn valituilta palveluntuottajilta, materiaaleissa mainituin poikkeuksin. Tampereen kaupunki on tapahtumien vastuullinen järjestäjä tai tilojen ja alueiden virallinen hallinnoija. Hankinnan kohteena olevat tapahtumatekniikan palvelut sisältävät kokonaisvaltaiset tapahtumatekniikan toteutukset tai yksittäiset laite- ja kalustovuokraukset. Hankittavan tapahtumatekniikan laajuus vaihtelee tapahtuman luonteesta sekä kohderyhmästä riippuen. Tapahtumatekniikan Tarjoaja voi käyttää toteutuksessa asianmukaisia alihankkijoita, mutta vastaa alihankkijoiden toteutuksesta kuin omastaan. Tarjoajan tulee pystyä kommunikoimaan suomeksi sekä kirjallisesti että suullisesti. Tarvittaessa Tarjoajalta odotetaan kykyä pystyä toteuttamaan palvelua myös englanniksi. Tapahtumatekniikan hankinta tehdään puitejärjestelynä, johon sisältyvät seuraavat osa-alueet: • Osa-alue 1: Suuret tapahtumat (yli 1000 osallistujaa). Valitaan enintään 4 Tarjoajaa. • Osa-alue 2: Pienet tapahtumat (alle 1000 osallistujaa). Valitaan enintään 4 Tarjoajaa. • Osa-alue 3: Kaluston vuokraaminen tapahtumiin. Valitaan enintään 4 Tarjoajaa. • Osa-alue 4: Elämyksellinen valaistus kaupunkitilassa. Valitaan enintään 4 Tarjoajaa. Osa-alueisiin 1, 2 ja 4 valituilla palveluntuottajilla tulee olla osoitettua kokemusta aiemmasta tapahtumien järjestämisestä.

description: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​Предмет на обществената поръчка е: „Следгаранционно сервизно и техническо обслужване, профилактика, диагностика и ремонт на моторни превозни средства, собственост на ТП „ДГС-Панагюрище“ (в т.ч. мотоциклети, автомобили, микробуси, камиони, самосвали, каросерии, ремаркета и полуремаркета), включително доставка на резервни части и консумативи за срок от 24 месеца“.Предметния обхват на настоящата обществена поръчка не включва обособени позиции. Услугите и свързаните с тях доставки, предмет на процедурата, са неделими по своето предназначение с оглед постигане целите на Възложителя. Същите следва да бъдат изпълнявани при спазване на препоръките на производителите на превозните средства, като извършването на услугите по ремонт и сервизно обслужване е неизменно свързано (както с цел спазване на кратки срокове за изпълнение, така и с оглед качеството им) с доставката на необходимите за това резервни части и консумативи с цел максимално ефективно, безопасно и безаварийно използване на същите по предназначение. Обсегът на услугите и свързаните с тях доставки, касаещ вида на превозните средства и на предвидените прогнозни артикули, обхваща такива от един тип, неизискващи специализирана към конкретни видове и категории превозни средства насоченост и практика. Възлагането на поръчката на различни изпълнители би създало технически и организационни затруднения за Възложителя при изпълнението на обществената поръчка

title: Finland – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Technical Consultancy Services Related to Rolling Stock
description: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE PROCUREMENT RailStock Finland Oy (hereinafter “Railstock”) is launching a tendering procedure for technical consultancy services related to the rolling stock it manages. The purpose of this procurement is to establish a framework for obtaining high‑quality, independent technical consultancy services that support Railstock in the management, development and procurement of rolling stock used in publicly funded passenger rail services in Finland. CONTRACTING ENTITY Railstock Finland Oy is a company wholly owned by the State of Finland, which manages, develops and leases passenger rolling stock for publicly funded passenger rail services in Finland. The objective of the company is to ensure that the rolling stock used in contracted services is safe, modern, low‑emission and available to all operators on equal and transparent terms, so that competition in rail transport and sustainable modes of transport can develop. Railstock is responsible for the preparation and implementation of new rolling stock procurements, for lifecycle management of the rolling stock and for long‑term investment planning. The company began operating as an independent company under the ownership steering of the Prime Minister’s Office in November 2025, and practical operational activities have commenced during 2026 as rolling stock used in contracted services, transferred from VR and other parties, is brought into the company’s ownership. SCOPE OF THE PROCUREMENT The subject matter of the procurement is a comprehensive package of technical expert and consultancy services related to rolling stock, supporting the rolling stock owner in, inter alia, technical assessments, procurement preparation, lifecycle management, planning of maintenance and heavy overhauls, safety and approval matters, as well as other expert tasks connected with the ownership and development of rolling stock. Railstock has divided the procurement into the following lots: 1. Owner’s Engineer Support 2. Procurement Support (Rolling Stock) 3. Lifecycle, LCC & Fleet Strategy 4. Safety, Regulation & ECM Certification 5. Testing, Acceptance, Audits & QA 6. Maintenance, Overhaul & Modification Procurement 7. ESG Reporting 8. IT Systems, Network Architecture & Cybersecurity 9. Technical Design (Electrical & Mechanical) 10. ETCS Retrofit & Upgrade Procurement Support 11. Rolling Stock Documentation Management & DMS Support The lots and the services to be procured under each lot are described in more detail in the invitation to tender and its annexes, which also set out Railstock’s requirements concerning the suitability of tenderers and the minimum requirements applicable to the services. PROCUREMENT DOCUMENTS The procurement documents consist of the following documents: - This contract notice - Annex 1: Draft Agreement - Annex 1.1: Data Protection, Information Security and Confidentiality Annex - Annex 1.2: Sanctions undertakings - Annex 2.1: Service description, Lot 1 - Annex 2.2: Service description, Lot 2 - Annex 2.3: Service description, Lot 3 - Annex 2.4: Service description, Lot 4 - Annex 2.5: Service description, Lot 5 - Annex 2.6: Service description, Lot 6 - Annex 2.7: Service description, Lot 7 - Annex 2.8: Service description, Lot 8 - Annex 2.9: Service description, Lot 9 - Annex 2.10: Service description, Lot 10 - Annex 2.11: Service description, Lot 11 - Annex 3.1: Tender Form, Lot 1 - Annex 3.2: Tender Form, Lot 2 - Annex 3.3: Tender Form, Lot 3 - Annex 3.4: Tender Form, Lot 4 - Annex 3.5: Tender Form, Lot 5 - Annex 3.6: Tender Form, Lot 6 - Annex 3.7: Tender Form, Lot 7 - Annex 3.8: Tender Form, Lot 8 - Annex 3.9: Tender Form, Lot 9 - Annex 3.10: Tender Form, Lot 10 - Annex 3.11: Tender Form, Lot 11 - Annex 4: Subcontractors, capacity‑providing entities and members of a group of tenderers PROCUREMENT TIMETABLE - Deadline for requests for additional information: 9 August 2026 - Answers to requests for additional information: at the latest 6 days before the tender submission deadline (target date: 12 August 2026) - Tender submission deadline: 30 August 2026 After this, the procurement will proceed according to the following indicative timetable: - Notification of the contract award decision: 18 September 2026 - Signing of the contract and start of the contract period: 9 October 2026

title: Available for Licensing: Behind-the-Meter Energy Management Technology for Peak Shaving and Load Shaping
description: Overview This technology is a control algorithm that manages behind-the-meter energy storage and onsite generation to perform peak shaving and load shaping in electrical power systems. Peak shaving reduces the highest points of electricity demand, while load shaping adjusts consumption and generation patterns over time to meet cost or operational goals. The intended value is twofold: reduced energy costs and demand charges for facility operators, and reduced strain on utility infrastructure during high-demand periods. The algorithm coordinates locally available battery storage and generation to draw on stored energy at the most advantageous times. A distinguishing design objective is scalability. Rather than being purpose-built for a single facility type, the same approach is intended to apply across residential, commercial, industrial, nanogrid, microgrid, and distribution-system contexts. It is designed to be deployed either as software integrated into a utility energy management system or as firmware on a standalone microcontroller for smaller installations. Industry Need Facility operators face rising electricity costs driven in part by demand charges tied to peak usage, while utilities face the cost and complexity of meeting concentrated demand peaks and managing grid congestion. Many existing peak-shaving and load-shaping solutions are built for a specific facility type or grid context, which introduces scalability, interoperability, and flexibility constraints when the same capability is needed across different system sizes or configurations. This can require redesign or separate tooling for each deployment. In parallel, critical facilities such as hospitals and defense installations require dependable operation and improved energy security, including the ability to continue functioning when disconnected from the main grid. These pressures create demand for a single adaptive method that coordinates existing storage and generation assets across varied operating conditions. Differentiation & Advantages Designed as a single generic approach intended to scale from a few kilowatts to tens of megawatts, and across voltages from residential 120 V to 66 kV sub-transmission. Uses a two-stage method: proactive hour-ahead scheduling based on forecasts, followed by real-time adjustment based on measured conditions. Incorporates weather and meteorological data to improve forecasting of onsite generation and load. Adapts usable battery state-of-charge range to energy-security needs, reserving a narrower range where only a single fuel source is available. Designed to respond to utility demand-response commands, price signals, and technical constraint signals, and to operate in both grid-connected and islanded modes. Potential Applications Residential, commercial, and industrial facilities seeking to reduce demand charges and energy costs. Nanogrids and microgrids requiring coordinated control of local storage and generation. Utility distribution systems using the method to support peak reduction and congestion management. Critical facilities such as hospitals and defense installations where energy security and continued operation are priorities. Deployments where local resources may also participate in balancing or regulating electricity markets. Partnering Opportunity This technology is available for collaboration through technology transfer, and this is not a procurement opportunity. We are not soliciting or acquiring services, products, or contract work. Instead, we are seeking industry partners interested in licensing, co-development, or evaluation of the technology for commercial application. Ideal partners may include power-system software developers, energy technology firms, and electric utilities positioned to advance the technology toward deployment. Interested organizations are encouraged to reach out to discuss licensing terms, joint development pathways, or evaluation arrangements.

title: Land Mobile Radio - Subscriber Equipment
description: This justification supports a limited sources acquisition under the Land Mobile Radio Support Equipment (LMR-SE) vehicle for a potential award to either AEG or Ewings. title: Technical Consultancy Services Related to Rolling Stock
description: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE PROCUREMENT RailStock Finland Oy (hereinafter “Railstock”) is launching a tendering procedure for technical consultancy services related to the rolling stock it manages. The purpose of this procurement is to establish a framework for obtaining high‑quality, independent technical consultancy services that support Railstock in the management, development and procurement of rolling stock used in publicly funded passenger rail services in Finland. CONTRACTING ENTITY Railstock Finland Oy is a company wholly owned by the State of Finland, which manages, develops and leases passenger rolling stock for publicly funded passenger rail services in Finland. The objective of the company is to ensure that the rolling stock used in contracted services is safe, modern, low‑emission and available to all operators on equal and transparent terms, so that competition in rail transport and sustainable modes of transport can develop. Railstock is responsible for the preparation and implementation of new rolling stock procurements, for lifecycle management of the rolling stock and for long‑term investment planning. The company began operating as an independent company under the ownership steering of the Prime Minister’s Office in November 2025, and practical operational activities have commenced during 2026 as rolling stock used in contracted services, transferred from VR and other parties, is brought into the company’s ownership. SCOPE OF THE PROCUREMENT The subject matter of the procurement is a comprehensive package of technical expert and consultancy services related to rolling stock, supporting the rolling stock owner in, inter alia, technical assessments, procurement preparation, lifecycle management, planning of maintenance and heavy overhauls, safety and approval matters, as well as other expert tasks connected with the ownership and development of rolling stock. Railstock has divided the procurement into the following lots: 1. Owner’s Engineer Support 2. Procurement Support (Rolling Stock) 3. Lifecycle, LCC & Fleet Strategy 4. Safety, Regulation & ECM Certification 5. Testing, Acceptance, Audits & QA 6. Maintenance, Overhaul & Modification Procurement 7. ESG Reporting 8. IT Systems, Network Architecture & Cybersecurity 9. Technical Design (Electrical & Mechanical) 10. ETCS Retrofit & Upgrade Procurement Support 11. Rolling Stock Documentation Management & DMS Support The lots and the services to be procured under each lot are described in more detail in the invitation to tender and its annexes, which also set out Railstock’s requirements concerning the suitability of tenderers and the minimum requirements applicable to the services. title: Rat Housing Infrastructure Modernization � Individually Ventilated Caging (IVC) Rack System Replacement
description: This notice is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items using Simplified Acquisition Procedures. This acquisition will be made in accordance with the format in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Subpart 12.6 �Streamlined Procedures for Evaluation and Solicitation for Commercial Items,� as applicable, and as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation (a written solicitation will not be issued) and quotes are being requested. The Solicitation number is RFQ-PCA-ORS-09463 and the solicitation is issued as a Request for Quotes (RFQ). This acquisition will be processed under FAR Part 13 Simplified Acquisition Procedures (SAP). The solicitation documents and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular (FAC) 2024-05 May 22, 2024. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this procurement is NAICS Code: 339112 � Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing, with a size standard of 1000 employees. The requirement is being competed with a brand name restriction, and with a total small business set-aside. The government intends to award a firm-fixed-price purchase order to the offeror responsible as a result of this RFQ that will include the terms and conditions set forth herein. By submitting a quote, the offeror is accepting that all government terms and conditions shall prevail over the award. By submission of a quote, the Offeror acknowledges the requirement that a prospective awardee shall be registered and viewable in the System for Award Management (SAM) database prior to award, during performance, and through final payment resulting from this solicitation (www.sam.gov). STATEMENT OF NEED The Division of Veterinary Resources (DVR), within the Office of Research Services (ORS), National Institutes of Health (NIH), requires the procurement, delivery, installation, commissioning, and training associated with an expansion of its existing Tecniplast individually ventilated caging (IVC) rack system for rats at NIH facilities located in Bethesda, Maryland. DVR currently operates a Tecniplast demonstration/pilot rack system for rat housing, and this acquisition will procure additional Tecniplast-compatible ER1050 racks, cages, Zephyr Touch air handling units, and related components necessary to expand rat housing capacity while maintaining full technical and operational compatibility with the existing installed system. Continuous access to a single, compatible ventilated caging platform is critical to maintaining animal welfare, biocontainment integrity, and compliance with federal regulations governing laboratory animal care. Place of Performance: NIH, 9000 Rockville Pike, Bethesda, MD 20892 United States. FOB: Destination PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE Delivery is requested as soon as possible. Estimated lead time for delivery is 12-14 weeks from date of award, if not sooner. EVALUATION NIH will evaluate quotes to determine the best value to the government. NIH will make that determination based on technical acceptability, price, and past performance. NIH will evaluate price only for those quotes which are rated as technically acceptable. In the event quotes are evaluated as technically equal, price will become a major consideration in selecting the successful Offeror. SPECIAL NOTICE TO OFFERORS Offerors are advised that the Government may share your information with non-government personnel who are assisting with the evaluation of quotes. The exclusive responsibility for source selection will reside with the Government. description: Advance Contract Award Notice (ACAN) Title: CubeSat Mission 1 – Osiris-3 Payload 1. Definition of ACAN An Advance Contract Award Notice (ACAN) is a public notice informing suppliers that Canada intends to award a contract for goods or services to a pre-identified supplier and invites other suppliers to express their interest by submitting a statement of capabilities. If no supplier submits a statement of capabilities that meets the requirements set out in this ACAN by the closing date stated in this notice, Canada may proceed with the award to the pre-identified supplier. 2. Requirement The Canadian Space Agency (CSA) has a requirement for the provision of the Osiris-3 payload for CubeSat Mission 1, including all associated services and technical support required for payload design, development, manufacturing, integration, testing, sustaining engineering, delivery, commissioning, and mission operations. Osiris-3, is a Canadian-developed atmospheric remote sensing instrument designed for deployment on a CubeSat platform. The payload will support atmospheric composition measurements using limb-scattering spectroscopy techniques and will contribute to the Government of Canada’s advancement of space-based Earth observation and atmospheric monitoring capabilities. 3. Suppliers’ Right to Submit a Statement of Capabilities Suppliers who consider themselves fully qualified and available to meet the requirements described in this ACAN may submit a written Statement of Capabilities to the Contracting Authority identified in this notice on or before the closing date and time. Statements of Capabilities must be submitted by email to the Contracting Authority prior to the closing date and time specified in this notice. 4. Criteria for assessment of the statement of capabilities (Minimum Essential Requirements) The supplier must provide sufficient objective evidence to demonstrate compliance with each essential requirement. Evidence may include, but is not limited to, technical reports, engineering analyses, scientific publications, test results, validation reports, qualification records, mission references, interface specifications, intellectual property documentation, and other verifiable supporting documentation. The burden of proof rests with the supplier. Assertions of capability, experience, or equivalency that are not supported by objective evidence will not be considered sufficient. CSA will assess the evidence provided against each essential requirement. Failure to provide sufficient evidence of demonstrating compliance with any one of the essential requirements may result in the Statement of Capabilities being deemed insufficient. No Minimum Essential Requirements Minimum Evidence Required 1 Capability to generate atmospheric remote-sensing data products that are scientifically comparable to those expected from the OSIRIS-3 mission concept. Performance specifications; Retrieval algorithms; Validation results; Published science results; Sample atmospheric data products; and Mission reports. 2 Technical expertise in atmospheric remote-sensing payloads Project references, resumes of key personnel, technical publications, mission experience, or descriptions of previous atmospheric remote-sensing projects. 3 Compatibility with a 16U CubeSat platform Interface specifications, engineering analyses, spacecraft accommodation studies, mass and power budgets, qualification reports, or equivalent technical documentation. 4 Ability to support payload integration and operations Integration plans, operations concepts, mission support experience, commissioning procedures, or references from previous missions. 5 Science-quality data generation capability Calibration reports, validation reports, instrument performance results, scientific publications, or evidence of previous operational use. 6 Technical maturity and spaceflight readiness Environmental test reports, qualification testing results, flight heritage, technology demonstrations, TRL assessments, or other evidence demonstrating readiness for spaceflight implementation. 7 Intellectual property rights and technical authority Documentation demonstrating ownership, licensing rights, design authority, or legal authority to use and modify the payload design, software, algorithms, or associated technologies. 5. Security Requirement There is no security requirement associated with this procurement. 6. Set-aside under the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business This procurement is not subject to any set-asides for Indigenous suppliers. 7. Comprehensive Land Claims Agreement(s) This procurement is not subject to any modern treaties or Comprehensive Land Claims Agreements. 8. Justification for the Pre-Identified Supplier As part of CubeSat Mission 1 mission planning, the Canadian Space Agency (CSA) assessed mission options and identified the Osiris-3 payload as the required payload to meet the mission's scientific objectives. The proposed approach is based on the University of Saskatchewan's role as the developer of the Osiris-3 payload and its possession of the technical expertise, design authority, background intellectual property, proprietary knowledge, and development experience associated with the payload. The University has established knowledge of the payload architecture, interfaces, calibration methodology, operational concepts, and performance characteristics required to complete the remaining development, integration, testing, commissioning, and operational support activities. The University of Saskatchewan has been identified as the only known viable source capable of providing these services based on its ownership and control of the relevant background intellectual property, its role as the original developer of the payload, and its demonstrated expertise in atmospheric remote sensing instrumentation. While intellectual property considerations form part of the justification, the primary basis for this requirement is the University's unique combination of: • Design authority for the Osiris-3 payload; • Specialized scientific and engineering expertise; • Proprietary technical knowledge and development experience; • Established understanding of the payload architecture, interfaces, calibration approach, and operational concepts; and • Continuity of development activities from design through mission operations. Engaging an alternative supplier would require significant knowledge of transfer, redevelopment, design validation, qualification, integration, and mission assurance activities. This would introduce substantial additional cost, schedule impacts, and technical risk, including the potential loss of continuity in payload development and scientific performance. Such impacts would be incompatible with the mission objectives, available resources, and project schedule. Based on the information available to CSA, no alternative supplier is currently known to possess the same combination of technical capability, design knowledge, intellectual property access, and continuity necessary to further develop, integrate, test, commission, and support the OSIRIS-3 payload without introducing unacceptable technical, schedule, and mission risks. 9. title: Available for Licensing: Fluorescent Tracer Technology for Hydrofluoric Acid Exposure Detection
description: Technology Licensing Opportunity: This technology is available for licensing through Idaho National Laboratory's (INL) Technology Deployment office. INL is not seeking to procure products or services in connection with this technology, and no procurement activity is associated with INL's technology transfer process. Interested parties are invited to contact INL to discuss licensing terms and partnership opportunities. Overview Hydrofluoric acid (HF) is used across petroleum refining, semiconductor manufacturing, glass processing, pharmaceutical synthesis, mineral processing, and laboratory research, among others. Despite established handling protocols, accidental skin or surface contact remains a persistent hazard � compounded by HF's unusual toxicological profile: at low concentrations, early-stage contact produces no pain, burning, or visible irritation, while damage to subcutaneous tissue and bone progresses silently before symptoms appear. This technology introduces a UV-fluorescent tracer additive created froma xanthene powder.. The additive is designed to remain chemically inert while enabling workers to survey skin, clothing, or surfaces using a UV light source after handling. Fluorescence indicates contact, supporting immediate decontamination and first aid before acid penetrates tissue. The approach is intended as a complementary detection layer alongside existing personal protective equipment and engineering controls. Industry Need Current HF safety practice relies on prevention: chemical-resistant PPE, engineered containment, and procedural controls. These measures reduce exposure frequency but do not eliminate the risk of accidental contact, particularly in production environments or during equipment maintenance. No field-deployable method currently exists for workers to confirm the absence of skin or surface contact after an HF-handling task. The standard indicator of exposure is symptom onset, which may occur hours after contact, after significant physiological damage has already occurred. This detection gap represents a structural limitation in current HF safety frameworks across all affected industries. Differentiation and Advantages Post-task detection capability: Designed to enable active worker self-survey after HF handling, a capability not provided by current commercial safety approaches. Chemically inert tracer formulation: Xanthene dye has documented chemical stability in HF environments and is not expected to alter acid reactivity, concentration, or intended function. Early-window treatment support: Detection prior to symptom onset is intended to expand the effective window for decontamination and calcium gluconate application, both of which are more effective when administered early. Leak detection in system processes: Secondarily, this product improves leak detection in industrial processes by creating a high visibility and distinct HF appearance that can reduce detection time and differentiate HF from other clear fluids used in the process. Potential Applications Industrial HF handling operations in petroleum refining, semiconductor etch, glass manufacturing, and pharmaceutical synthesis. Worker post-task self-survey using portable UV light sources following HF-handling tasks. Facility leak and spill detection through UV scanning of work surfaces and equipment exteriors. Laboratory and small-scale research environments where engineering controls may be less robust.

title: Edge Database Subscriptions for the Service Center Operations Directorate (SCOPS)
description: The mission of USCIS is to administer the immigration and naturalization laws of the United States. USCIS must ensure customers receive timely and accurate information, and correctly adjudicated benefit applications and petitions through a commitment to excellence, courtesy, process improvement and customer satisfaction. SCOPS supports the USCIS mission by providing accurate and useful information to our customers, granting immigration and citizenship benefits, promoting an awareness, and understanding of citizenship, and ensuring the integrity of our immigration systems. To support this mission, SCOPS requires an unlimited subscription to access the American Association of Collegiate Registrars and Admission Officers (AACRAO) Electronic Database for Global Education (EDGE) system to determine foreign applicant education validity. AACRAO shall provide unlimited access to the EDGE online system for USCIS SCOPS and AAO program offices. The USCIS adjudication officers utilize EDGE information to support their decision and determine foreign applicant education validity. EDGE offers a thorough description of the educational systems for each country in the world. If there are divergent pathways for academic qualifications and skilled work qualifications, EDGE maps and describes those in extraordinary detail. Each academic and professional qualification is explained as the prerequisites for those qualifications. EDGE then describes how those various qualifications equate to academic and skilled qualifications which are offered in the United States. Further, EDGE describes how the various qualifications may be used to pursue additional academic qualifications. The amount of data which EDGE provides, as well as the level of detail aids USCIS in performing the level of analysis that is required for Adjudication Officers determinations. Further, if there is an academic or skilled qualification which is not yet identified in EDGE, USCIS will contact EDGE with a request. EDGE Country designated contact will then perform the research to obtain a description of the previously unidentified qualification and notify USCIS of the update to EDGE.

title: Intent to Sole Source - Water Filter System
description: This is a Notice of Intent, not a request for proposal. The National Institute of Health, Clinical Center (NIH-CC) intends to negotiate on an other than full and open competition basis with the following vendor: Aldevra. Acquistion Description: The purpose of this requirement is to provide a fixed-price contract to buy replacement Ice Water Dispenser (IWD) Filter Assembly to support patient care in the CC. Ice and water dispensing machines used in health care facilities are often different from those used in the food service industry. Opportunistic pathogens of premise plumbing are germs that grow well in drinking water distribution systems and can cause disease in humans. Examples of these include Pseudomonas, Acinetobacter, Burkholderia, Stenotrophomonas, nontuberculous mycobacteria, various species of fungi, and Naegleria fowleri. Many of the environmental factors that are conducive for Legionella growth also allow for growth of these other opportunistic pathogens. There is an added emphasis on sanitation when ice and water dispensing units are used on patient care units, so countertop, hands-free, nugget ice is easily chewable and helps reduce choking risks among patients. The requirement is to provide IWDs filters hat are designed specifically to meet the long-term reliability and performance of regulatory standards (Joint Commission, HACCP, NSF) required for medications, vaccines, lab reagents, specimens, and patient food. title: Intelligence Exploitation and Targeting Systems (IETS)
description: This amendment officially notifies industry that the Government intends to award a hybrid contract utilizing both Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) and Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee (CPFF) Contract Line-Item Numbers (CLINs) for the IETS Follow-On effort. The Naval Air Warfare Center Weapons Division at China Lake, CA intends to procure on full and open competitive basis: this effort is to provide research, development, testing and evaluation (RDTE), for the development and fielding of Development and Fielding of Intelligence Exploitation and Targeting Systems (IETS) systems/prototypes related to future systems or the sustainment of deployed systems. This requirement will focus on the continued delivery and fielding of IETS that are based upon or derived from the Common Geo-Positioning (CGS) package of software and related hardware components deployed in the Distributed Common Ground System Navy (DCGS) family of Programs by the Army, the Air Force, DCGS-N and the Marines Corps as well as in intelligence training centers operated by each of the Services and operational installations worldwide. IETS requirements are also applicable to similar systems deployed by Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR) Program Manager for Acquisition (PMA) organizations (i.e., Precision Strike Weapons Program Office (PMA-201), Program Manager Air (PMA-265), Strike Planning and Execution Systems (PMA-281) and Maritime Patrol and Reconnaissance Aircraft program office (PMA-290)) and NGA systems deployed in Combatant Command operations centers and Joint Intelligence or Analysis Centers. title: Tar Lake Superfund
description: Pre Solicitation Notice Tar Lake SuperfundTHIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL OR INVITATION FOR BID. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Detroit District is seeking a contractor to provide environmental services for the excavation of contaminated soil and expansion of a bio-sparge system at the Tar Lake Superfund Site in Mancelona Township, MI. The project will involve excavation of approximately 172,500 tons of contaminated soil with temporary shoring, backfilling with clean imported soils, installing 45 new bio-sparge wells, and an approximately 160 square foot pre-engineered structure to house the compressors. Ancillary activities include abandoning existing groundwater monitoring wells, installing new groundwater monitoring wells, installing erosion control measures, conducting a utility survey to locate existing bio-sparge system piping, confirmation soil sampling, and site restoration. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Detroit District intends to issue an Invitation for Bid (IFB) to award a single firm fixed-price environmental services project. The base contract consists of work associated with environmental excavation of the Tar Lake Superfund Site in Mancelona Township, Michigan. There is one (1) option included with the solicitation. General Information: The Government intends to solicit this opportunity as an Invitation for Bid (IFB) as a 100% set-aside for small business. The Government intends to issue a firm-fixed price contract. A bid bond is required. The North American Industrial Classification (NAICS) code for this work is 562910 (Exception), Environmental Remediation Services, which has a small business size standard of up to 1,000 employees. The Solicitation is anticipated to be issued August 2026. The solicitation package materials, documents, drawings, specifications, and attachments will be available only electronically and via SAM.gov where there will be a link to the attachments which will be stored in the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) system. Electronic submission is required through the PIEE Solicitation Module suite at https://piee.eb.mil/. All contractors must be registered on both sam.gov and PIEE. The Government will NOT supply hard copy documents to any interested parties as a result of this solicitation.Please note: the Government will NOT maintain a bidders list during the solicitation period.Interested contractor must have an active registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) prior to submission of proposals to be eligible to conduct business with the Federal Government. title: Health Care Delivery System (HCDS) Electronic Health Record Follow-on (MHS GENESIS)
description: The Government is hosting an Industry Day in the Washington D.C. area the first week of November 2025. The exact date, time, and location will be announced shortly. This is an in-person event only. Attendance is limited to a maximum of three (3) representatives per company, as capacity is capped at 150 attendees. The purpose of this Industry Day is to provide industry partners with updates on the MHS GENESIS recompete, including the target timeline for solicitation(s) and key areas where the Government will seek industry engagement. Presentation materials and other relevant information will be made available on SAM.gov and Defense Health Agency (DHA) social media channels shortly after the event for those unable to attend. Background & Overview � Program Executive Office, Defense Healthcare Management Systems (PEO DHMS) is planning for a competitive award to support the Federal Electronic Health Record (EHR). The new contract strategy focuses on the following priorities: � Keeping pace with commercial technology advancements, leveraging the commercial ecosystem for defense systems, rapidly delivering scaled digital capabilities, and evolving our systems faster than adversaries can adapt on the battlefield. � Reducing the timeline required to compete follow-on efforts. � Tightening integration with the Veterans Affairs (VA) and other Federal agencies who require Electronic Health Information. � Improving efficiency in the delivery of healthcare and long-term sustainability of information technology investments. � Where appropriate, leveraging a compensation model for EHR contractor(s) based on healthcare value delivered rather than on activity, capability, or consumption. � Ensuring the best-in-class specialized methodology developed under the incumbent contract for successful EHR deployment remains available for the Department of War (DoW) and Federal agencies.

Background & Overview � Program Executive Office, Defense Healthcare Management Systems (PEO DHMS) is planning for a competitive award to support the Federal Electronic Health Record (EHR). The new contract strategy focuses on the following priorities: � Keeping pace with commercial technology advancements, leveraging the commercial ecosystem for defense systems, rapidly delivering scaled digital capabilities, and evolving our systems faster than adversaries can adapt on the battlefield. � Reducing the timeline required to compete follow-on efforts. � Tightening integration with the Veterans Affairs (VA) and other Federal agencies who require Electronic Health Information. � Improving efficiency in the delivery of healthcare and long-term sustainability of information technology investments. � Where appropriate, leveraging a compensation model for EHR contractor(s) based on healthcare value delivered rather than on activity, capability, or consumption. � Ensuring the best-in-class specialized methodology developed under the incumbent contract for successful EHR deployment remains available for the Department of War (DoW) and Federal agencies.

title: Q523--Intraoperative Neuromonitoring (IONM) Services South Texas Veterans Health Care System
description: Pre-solicitation Notice Pre-solicitation Notice Page 3 of 3 Pre-solicitation Notice *=Required Field Pre-solicitation Notice Page 1 of 3 DESCRIPTION The Department of Veterans Affairs, South Texas Veterans Healthcare System (STXVHCS), Audie L. Murphy VA Medical Center, 7400 Merton Minter Blvd, San Antonio, TX, 78229 through the El Paso VA Contracting Office, intends to solicit proposals from Service Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) contractors to provide Intraoperative Neuromonitoring (IONM) services under an Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity Contract (IDIQ), with an anticipated period of performance of a base year and four (4) one-year option periods. The VA anticipates issuing a solicitation for this requirement on or about 1 August 2026, with an estimated closing date for proposals on or about 30 August 2026. The solicitation will be available for download from https://sam.gov. Interested offerors will be responsible for downloading copies of solicitation (and any subsequent amendments) from that website, and no hard copies will be made available. The solicitation will provide full information to contractors about the proposal submission process. Prospective offerors are encouraged to register their interest in the solicitation on the System for Award Management (SAM.gov) website so that they are notified of the issuance of the solicitation and any amendments. The services required include: On site Certified Neurophysiologic Intraoperative Monitoring (CNIM) technologists Remote oversight by Board Certified Neurophysiologists (Neurology/Physiatry/DABNM/privileged Neurosurgeon) Full provision of all equipment, materials, disposable supplies, and IT connectivity Real time IONM monitoring and communication with surgical teams 24/7/365 coverage with defined emergency response requirements Credentialing and privileging prior to clinical work Compliance with all VA Directives, infection control, immunizations, mandatory training, CME/CEU, QA logs, incident reporting, and documentation standards Services will be provided to VHA healthcare-eligible Veterans of the STVHCS. PSC Code G523, Medical - Surgery, North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code is 621399, Office of All Other Miscellaneous Health Practitioners, Small Business Size Standard $10.0M. Please hold questions until the actual release of the solicitation. All potential offerors are encouraged to read over the entire solicitation package including attachments before submitting questions. NO TELEPHONE REQUESTS WILL BE ACCEPTED. All responsible offerors are invited to submit an offer which shall be considered by the agency. Any Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB) must be registered in the Small Business Administration s Small Business Search (https://search.certifications.sba.gov/). It is the responsibility of the offerors to check the website periodically for any amendments/notices to the solicitation. No individual notification of amendments/notices will be provided. INCUMBENT: Risen Video Production LLC End of Document

description: The Pearl Harbor Naval Shipyard and Intermediate Maintenance Facility (PHNSY & IMF) is issuing a request for quote (RFQ) for a firm fixed price contract for a Hot Oil Flush of External Hydraulics Systems onboard a Los Angeles-class submarine in accordance with HIRMC -501-27. This posting serves as a solicitation in association with N32253-26-Q-0057. The tentative Period of Performance is 27 November 2026 to 08 January 2027. The solicitation number for this requirement is N32253-26-Q-0057. Proposals are due on 30 August 2026 at 0900 HST. Submissions are to be emailed to both the primary and secondary point of contact listed in this posting. This solicitation is issued in accordance with Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Part 12, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisitions Circular (FAC) 2026-01, DFARS (05/07/2026), and NMCARS 18-22. This requirement is a 100% small business set-aside. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code assigned to this procurement is 336611 and the standard size for this NAICS code is 1,300 employees. The Product Service Code is J020 - Maint/Repair/Rebuild of Equipment - Ship and Marine Equipment. All firms or individuals responding must be registered with the System for Award Management (SAM) https://www.sam.gov by the award date. Please note the following for N32253-26-Q-0057: Addendum to FAR 52.212-1 Instructions to Offeror-Commercial Products and Commercial Services (Pages 43-46 of the RFQ) provides instructions on what documents must be included in your submission. Addendum to FAR 52.212-2 Evaluation-Commercial Products and Commercial Services (Pages 48-49 of the RFQ) provides evaluation factors upon which all submitted proposals will be evaluated. The deadline for receipt of questions is 21 August 2026. Although every effort will be made, the Government makes no guarantee that questions received after the date above will be answered. Site Visit: There will be no site visit opportunities for this requirement.

title: NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD A SOLE SOURCE BRIDGE MODIFICATION � Human Space Flight Support (HSFS) II - FA2521-21-F-0106
description: The 325th Contracting Squadron at Tyndall Air Force Base intends to issue a sole-source bridge modification to existing contract FA2521-21-F-0106, awarded to ManTech Advanced Systems International Incorporated (Cage: 5N741). This modification is critical to ensuring the uninterrupted continuation of mission-essential Human Space Flight Support (HSFS) II services for Detachment 3, Patrick Space Force Base, FL. This Firm-Fixed-Price sole-source bridge modification establishes a five-month base period of performance (10 September 2026 through 09 February 2027) and one three-month option period (10 February 2027 through 09 May 2027). The action is being executed under the Fair Opportunity Exception authority: FAR 16.505(b)(2)(i). The contractor shall provide continuous, uninterrupted execution of mission-critical Department of War (DoW) support to NASA's crewed space flight operations. This performance-based requirement provides continuity of essential operations for NASA's crewed space flight programs, including Artemis, Commercial Crew, and Soyuz missions. Services required under this effort include, but are not limited to, the planning, coordination, execution, and sustainment of DoW capabilities to support launch, landing, and contingency operations for human spaceflight missions. THIS IS A NOTICE OF INTENT AND NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS. No solicitation will be issued. The redacted Justification and Approval (J&A) for this action will be provided at a later date.

title: Request For Expressions of Interest for Cook Hall Harpers Ferry, WV
description: The National Park Service (NPS) announces a Request for Expression of Interest (RFEI) seeking responses from individuals, educational institutions, governmental and quasi-governmental agencies or entities, and non-profit or for-profit organizations for use of the facility and associated lands located at 252 McDowell Street, Harpers Ferry, WV 25425 known as the Cook Hall. The building is a historic structure and has 9,970 square feet. It was constructed in 1939-1940 as a dormitory for Storer College. The complex includes two parking lots, one at the South side proximate to the building, 6 spaces, and another, at the rear of Shipley School, with approximately 20 spaces. Cook Hall has 30 rooms, a kitchen, storage space, laundry room, two meeting rooms and office space.

description: Hoosier National Forest, Tell City Ranger District located in Indiana, Dam Maintenance Project 1 consists of repairing erosion area in the Indian Lake Dam and Tipsaw Lake Auxiliary Spillway. title: Tapahtumatekniikan palveluiden hankinta
description: Hankinnan kohteena on tapahtumatekniikan palvelut ja laitevuokraus Tampereen kaupungin järjestämissä tapahtumissa tai hallinnoimissa tiloissa ja alueilla. Tampereen kaupunki tilaa tuottamiinsa tapahtumiin tai hallinnoimiinsa tiloihin ja alueille tapahtumatekniikkaa puitejärjestelyyn valituilta palveluntuottajilta, materiaaleissa mainituin poikkeuksin. Tampereen kaupunki on tapahtumien vastuullinen järjestäjä tai tilojen ja alueiden virallinen hallinnoija. Hankinnan kohteena olevat tapahtumatekniikan palvelut sisältävät kokonaisvaltaiset tapahtumatekniikan toteutukset tai yksittäiset laite- ja kalustovuokraukset. Hankittavan tapahtumatekniikan laajuus vaihtelee tapahtuman luonteesta sekä kohderyhmästä riippuen. Tapahtumatekniikan Tarjoaja voi käyttää toteutuksessa asianmukaisia alihankkijoita, mutta vastaa alihankkijoiden toteutuksesta kuin omastaan. Tarjoajan tulee pystyä kommunikoimaan suomeksi sekä kirjallisesti että suullisesti. Tarvittaessa Tarjoajalta odotetaan kykyä pystyä toteuttamaan palvelua myös englanniksi. Tapahtumatekniikan hankinta tehdään puitejärjestelynä, johon sisältyvät seuraavat osa-alueet: • Osa-alue 1: Suuret tapahtumat (yli 1000 osallistujaa). Valitaan enintään 4 Tarjoajaa. • Osa-alue 2: Pienet tapahtumat (alle 1000 osallistujaa). Valitaan enintään 4 Tarjoajaa. • Osa-alue 3: Kaluston vuokraaminen tapahtumiin. Valitaan enintään 4 Tarjoajaa. • Osa-alue 4: Elämyksellinen valaistus kaupunkitilassa. Valitaan enintään 4 Tarjoajaa. Osa-alueisiin 1, 2 ja 4 valituilla palveluntuottajilla tulee olla osoitettua kokemusta aiemmasta tapahtumien järjestämisestä. , Suuret tapahtumat Tampereen kaupunki järjestää vuosittain kaikille avoimia ja pääsymaksuttomia suuria yleisötilaisuuksia, joissa osallistujamäärät vaihtelevat tyypillisesti 4 000–10 000 henkilön välillä. Tapahtumat järjestetään pääsääntöisesti Tampereella, ulkotiloissa. Tapahtumien kesto voi vaihdella muutaman tunnin tilaisuuksista useamman päivän toteutuksiin. Hankinnan piirissä on vuositasolla arviolta noin 3–5 suurta tapahtumaa. Tällaisia tapahtumia ovat esimerkiksi Valoviikkojen avajaiset, Itsenäisyyspäivän juhla sekä Filharmonian puistokonsertti. Suurten tapahtumien tarve hankinnan kohteessa kattaa kokonaisvaltaiset tapahtumatekniikan palvelut. Tarjoajalta odotetaan asiantuntemusta suunnitella ja toteuttaa tapahtuman vaatimat tekniset toteutusratkaisut kuten lava-, valaistus-, IMAG-, screen- ja muu av-tekniikka. Lisäksi tilaus voi sisältää tapahtuman elävöittämiseen liittyviä valaistustarpeita. Palvelutuottajan odotetaan vastaavan toteutettavan palvelun suunnittelusta, kasaamisesta, purusta sekä kuljetuksesta. Teknisten ratkaisuiden niin edellyttäessä Tarjoajalta edellytetään valmiutta järjestää palvelun mahdollisesti tarvitsemat aggregaatit sekä nettiyhteydet., Elämyksellinen valaistus kaupunkitilassa Tampereen kaupunki toteuttaa vuosittain projekteja, joissa elämyksellinen valaistus on merkittävässä osassa kaupunkitilan elävöittämistä. Pääsääntöisesti elämyksellinen valaistus toteutetaan Tampereella ulkotiloissa, vuoden pimeimpään aikaan. Toteutusten kesto vaihtelee useimmiten muutamista päivistä muutamiin viikkoihin. Valaistavat kohteet ja yksityiskohdat vaihtelevat vuositasolla tilaajan tarpeiden mukaan. Hankinnan piirissä on vuositasolla arviolta noin 1–3 toteutusta. Näitä projekteja viime vuosilta ovat esimerkiksi Keskustorin alueen rakennusten valaistukset ja Tanssivat vedet Tammerkoskessa. Elämyksellisellä valaistuksella tarkoitetaan tässä kohtaa palvelukokonaisuutta, jossa Tarjoaja toteuttaa tilaajan tarpeiden mukaisesti kaupunkitilaa elävöittävän valaistusratkaisun tiettyyn kohteeseen ennalta määritellylle ajanjaksolle. Elämyksellinen valaistus voi tarkoittaa esimerkiksi värivalopesua, projisointia tai muuta valolla kaupunkitilan ilmiöittämistä. Tarjoaja vastaa kokonaisvaltaisesti valaistusratkaisun toteuttamisesta, mukaan lukien sisällönsuunnittelu, tarvittavan laitteiston vuokraus, asennus, käyttö ja purku. Palvelu sisältää myös valaistuksen toteuttamiseen liittyvät lisäjärjestelyt, kuten tarvittavien telineiden, sähkösyöttöjen ja muiden teknisten rakenteiden hankinnan ja turvallisen käytön. Tarjoaja varmistaa, että kokonaisuus toimii laadukkaasti ja turvallisesti koko palvelun voimassaolon ajan. Hankittava palvelu ei pidä sisällään valotaidetta tai yleisten alueiden valaistukseen liittyvää asiantuntijapalvelua (kaupungilla erillinen puitesopimus Yleisten alueiden valaistus-, sähkö- ja tietoliikennealan asiantuntijapalveluista)., Kaluston vuokraaminen tapahtumiin Tampereen kaupunki järjestää omissa tiloissaan ja alueillaan erilaisia tapahtumia, jotka voivat vaatia yksittäisten AV-teknisten laitteiden tai laitekokonaisuuksien vuokraamista niin, että vuokraaminen ei vaadi Tarjoajan teknikon läsnäoloa tapahtumassa. Esimerkkeinä yksittäisen liikuteltavan kaiutinmikseriyhdistelmän vuokraaminen tapahtuman äänentoistoksi tai yksittäisen äänimikserin vuokraaminen tapahtumassa esiintyvän artistin teknikon käyttöön. Lisäksi voidaan haluta vuokrata tapahtumaan näyttöjä jalustoineen, led-seinä tai projektori projisointikankaan kanssa oman kuvasignaalin esittämiseen. Tapahtumaan saatetaan myös tarvita valaistus tai tapahtumaa halutaan elävöittää soveltuvalla valaistusratkaisulla. Tarjoajalla tulee olla valmius toimittaa tilatut tuotteet tilaajan toivomaan sijaintiin, tai mahdollisuus noutoon Tarjoajan varastolta. Tarjoajan tulee varmistaa laitteiden kunto, toiminta ja käytettävyys luovuttaessaan ne vuokraajan käyttöön. Tilaustiedustelut voidaan tehdä myös todella nopealla aikataululla, jos oma laitteisto hajoaa ja tarvitaan pikaisesti korvaavia laitteita, joten Tarjoajalla tulee olla mahdollisuus nopeaan puhelinasiointiin. Kaluston vuokraamisen tarpeen määrä vaihtelee vuosittain yksittäisistä tilauksista ylöspäin. Tampereen kaupungin tavoitteista ja budjetista riippuen järjestettävien tapahtumien määrä voi vaihdella ja järjestettävät tapahtumat tai vuokrattavan kaluston tarve voi muodostua myös yllä kuvatun listan ulkopuolelta. Luvut ovat sitoumuksettomia arvioita. Palveluja tilataan syntyvän tarpeen mukaan eikä tilaajalla ole määräostovelvoitetta., Pienet tapahtumat Tampereen kaupunki järjestää vuosittain useita pienempiä yleisö- ja kutsuvierastilaisuuksia, joissa osallistujamäärät vaihtelevat tyypillisesti muutaman kymmenen henkilön tilaisuudesta usean sadan henkilön tilaisuuksiin. Tapahtumat järjestetään pääsääntöisesti Tampereella, sisä- ja ulkotiloissa. Tapahtumien kesto voi vaihdella muutaman tunnin tilaisuuksista useamman päivän toteutuksiin. Hankinnan piirissä on vuositasolla arviolta noin 10 pientä tapahtumaa. Tällaisia tapahtumia ovat esimerkiksi Tampereen Raatihuoneen tilaisuudet. Pienten tapahtumien tarve hankinnan kohteessa kattaa kokonaisvaltaiset tapahtumatekniikan palvelut. Tarjoajalta odotetaan asiantuntemusta suunnitella ja toteuttaa tapahtuman vaatimat tekniset toteutusratkaisut kuten lava-, valaistus-, IMAG-, screen- ja muu av-tekniikka. Lisäksi tilaus voi sisältää tapahtuman elävöittämiseen liittyviä valaistustarpeita. Tarjoajan odotetaan vastaavan toteutettavan palvelun suunnittelusta, kasaamisesta, purusta sekä kuljetuksesta. Teknisten ratkaisuiden niin edellyttäessä Tarjoajalta edellytetään valmiutta järjestää palvelun mahdollisesti tarvitsemat aggregaatit sekä nettiyhteydet.,

title: Ikääntyneiden tehostettu palveluasuminen ajalle 1.9.2021 (tavoite) - 31.8.2026 ( 1v+ 1v optiot)
description: Tämä hankinta on siirtynyt sote-järjestyslain ja sote-voimaanpanolain (616/2021) 4 § nojalla Varsinais-Suomen hyvinvointialueelle. Varsinais-Suomen hyvinvointialue pyytää osallistumishakemuksia ikääntyneiden henkilöiden asumispalveluiden dynaamiseen toimittajarekisteriin. Dynaamiseen toimittajarekisteriin valitaan kaikki osallistumishakemuksen jättäneet ehdokkaat, jotka täyttävät tässä osallistumispyynnössä ilmoitetut vaatimukset. Varsinais-Suomen hyvinvointialue tekee hankinnan osalta päätöksen. Tilaaja tekee myöhemmin dynaamiseen toimittajarekisteriin valittujen Palveluntuottajien kanssa palveluyksikkökohtaisesti oman sopimuksen. Hankinta on jaettu neljään osakokonaisuuteen: 1. Ikääntyneiden tehostettu palveluasuminen suomenkielisille 2. Ikääntyneiden tehostettu palveluasuminen ruotsinkielisille 3. Vaativa muistisairaiden tehostettu palveluasuminen suomenkielisille 4. Vaativa muistisairaiden tehostettu palveluasuminen ruotsinkielisille Lisätietoja on osallistumispyynnössä sekä liitteillä 1-9. Sopimus tehdään enintään 31.8.2026 asti, minkä jälkeen sopimusta voidaan jatkaa tilaajan päätöksellä alkuperäisin ehdoin kahdella (2) yhden (1) vuoden optiolla ajalle 1.9.2026 - 31.8.2027 ja 1.9.2027 - 31.8.2028. Hankintaan sovelletaan julkisista hankinnoista ja käyttöoikeussopimuksista annetun lain (1397/2016, jäljempänä ''hankintalaki'') 12 luvun mahdollistamaa Tilaajan itse suunnittelemaa hankintamenettelyä (dynaaminen toimittajarekisteri), jonka tarkempi kuvaus on esitetty liitteellä 7 ''Dynaamisen toimittajarekisterin kuvaus ja periaatteet'' ja liitteellä 8 ''Dynaamisen toimittajarekisterin visualisointi''. Osallistumishakemus on annettava palveluyksikkökohtaisesti. Palveluyksiköllä tarkoitetaan palveluyksikköä, jolla on yhteiset toimitilat ja oma työvuorosuunnittelu ja joka toimii yhden esimiehen alaisuudessa. Osallistumishakemuksia voi jättää koko toimittajarekisterin voimassaolon ajan. Hyväksytyn osallistumishakemuksen käsittelyn jälkeen osallistumishakemuksen jättäneen ehdokkaan kanssa tehdään sopimus. Ehdokkaalla olla valmius aloittaa palvelun tuottaminen heti sopimuskauden alkaessa. Perustettavien yksiköiden osalta ehdokkaalla tulee olla valmius aloittaa palvelun tuottaminen neljä (4) kuukautta hankintapäätöksen lainvoimaisuuden jälkeen. Hankintapalvelut käsittelee uudet osallistumishakemukset ja Varsinais-Suomen hyvinvointialue tekee hankintapäätöksen Toimittajarekisteriin hyväksymisestä viimeistään neljän (4) kuukauden päästä osallistumishakemuksen jättämisestä. Tehostettu palveluasuminen on uuden lainsäädännön (1.1.2023) termein ympärivuorokautinen asuminen (sosiaalihuoltolaki 21 c § (26.8.2022/790). Hankintadokumenteissa käytetään kuitenkin edelleen hankinnan aloitushetkellä käytössä ollut termi tehostettu palveluasuminen. Ikääntyneiden tehostettu palveluasuminen suomenkielisille Suomenkielisten ikääntyneiden tehostetun palveluasumisen palvelusisältö on kuvattu tarkemmin liitteessä 1. Hankinta toteutetaan dynaamisena toimittajarekisterinä. Ikääntyneiden tehostettu palveluasuminen ruotsinkielisille Ruotsinkielisten ikääntyneiden tehostetun palveluasumisen palvelusisältö on kuvattu tarkemmin liitteessä 1. Hankinta toteutetaan dynaamisena toimittajarekisterinä. Vaativa muistisairaiden tehostettu palveluasuminen suomenkielisille Suomenkielisten muistisairaiden vaativan tehostetun palveluasumisen palvelusisältö on kuvattu tarkemmin liitteessä 1. Hankinta toteutetaan dynaamisena toimittajarekisterinä. Vaativa muistisairaiden tehostettu palveluasuminen ruotsinkielisille Ruotsinkielisten muistisairaiden vaativan tehostetun palveluasumisen palvelusisältö on kuvattu tarkemmin liitteessä 1. buyer: Ministerium für Land- und Ernährungswirtschaft, Umwelt und Verbraucherschutz des Landes Brandenburg
title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Projektmanagement für Leistungen zur Umsetzung des Maßnahmenplans des Landesniedrigwasserkonzeptes 2.0
description: Das MLEUV hat in Reaktion auf die ausgeprägte Trockenperiode ab 2018 das Landesniedrigwasser-konzept erarbeitet. Es wurde 2021 veröffentlicht und umfasst, vereinfacht ausgedrückt eine Strategie zur Konsolidierung des Landschaftswasserhaushaltes. Zum Ende des Jahres 2021 wurde zu diesem Zweck durch das MLEUV ein Auftragnehmer gebunden, um in allen Flussgebieten mittels eines strukturierten Prozesses eine Bestandsaufnahme durchzuführen und entsprechende Kommunikationsstrukturen zu schaffen, um darauf basierend notwendige Maßnahmen zur Stabilisierung des Wasserhaushaltes zu identifizieren, vorzubereiten und mit potenziellen Trägern zu initiieren. Die Umsetzung setzt vor allem auf die Zusammenarbeit der regionalen Akteure in den 16 Flussgebieten des Landes. Die Erarbeitung folgte grundsätzlich einem Bottom-up-Ansatz, d.h. unter enger Einbeziehung der regionalen Akteure (u.a. Wasser-, Umwelt- und Landwirtschaftsbehörden des Landes und der Landkreise / kreisfreien Städte, Gewässerunterhaltungsverbände), um regionales Wissen und Wünsche aufzunehmen, die Vorhaben ggf. zu qualifizieren und einer tragfähigen Finanzierung zuzuführen. Die Finanzierung von Maßnahmen sollte bevorzugt über die Förderrichtlinien "Landschaftswasserhaushalt" des Umweltressorts erfolgen. Ein in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem sog. Niedrigwasser-Team (am MLEUV) optimiertes fachliches Begleitverfahren bindet die Förderung in die Umsetzung des Landesniedrigwasserkonzeptes ein und gewährleistet, dass Antragsteller bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen fachlich unterstützt werden. Die sog. "Niedrigwasserkoordinatoren" (im Folgenden als "NW-Koordinatoren" bezeichnet) sind als Ansprechpartner in den Regionen eingeführt, die Abläufe von der Ideenfindung zur Projektkonzeption und -beantragung zusammen mit den Hauptantragstellern, den Gewässerunterhaltungsverbänden (GUV), etabliert sowie entsprechende Gremien zur Kommunikation des Themas "Niedrigwasser" in verschiedensten Konstellationen eingeführt (z.B. Kernteams aus Wasserbehörden, GUV, NW-Koordinatoren, LfU und ggf. Weitere). Der Auftrag endet im Oktober 2026. Er wird im Weiteren als "Erstauftrag zur Umsetzung des Landesniedrigwasserkonzeptes" (kurz: "Erstauftrag") bezeichnet. Der Erstauftrag soll in modifizierter, ergänzter und weiterentwickelter Form neu beauftragt werden. Diese vorliegende Leistungsbeschreibung bildet die Grundlage.

buyer: SBB CFF FFS Infra-Telecom und Elektroanlagen
title: Business Connectivity as a Service
description:
Les Chemins de fer fédéraux suisses (CFF) exploitent un réseau ferroviaire couvrant l’ensemble de la Suisse pour le trafic voyageurs et le trafic marchandises. Il est de la plus haute importance pour l’exploitation de disposer d’un réseau de données très performant et fiable. Il est utilisé aussi bien pour les applications critiques pour l’exploitation ferroviaire (p. ex. dans le domaine de l’arrêt automatique des trains et de l’acheminement automatique des trains, de la radio ferroviaire et de la gestion de l’énergie) que pour les applications liées au chemin de fer ou administratives (systèmes de régulation, systèmes de gestion). Le réseau de données, actuellement en service, touche à la fin de son cycle de vie.  


Afin d’accroître la rentabilité, des bâtiments entiers non déterminants pour l’exploitation ferroviaire ou certains étages de ceux-ci doivent par ailleurs être équipés, équipés et exploités par un prestataire de services selon le modèle «as a service». Dans le cadre du programme de renouvellement du réseau de données (AiNET), une décision «make or buy» est prise pour chaque bâtiment sur la base d’un calcul du coût total de propriété (TCO). 


 Comme des applications liées au chemin de fer sont également possibles dans le domaine de la Business Connectivity, deux degrés d’intégration différents sont exigés dans le réseau de données des CFF. Le prestataire de services doit donc être en mesure de répondre, outre la prestation habituelle telle que le raccordement du bâtiment, le LAN et le WLAN (Standard Business Connectivity), à des exigences supplémentaires conformément au cahier des charges dans le cadre du «as a service» (construction et exploitation).   


La prestation à acquérir porte sur la planification, la livraison, l’installation, l’exploitation, la surveillance, la maintenance et le développement continu de la solution. La prestation à acquérir porte sur des contrats de niveau de service clairs, des descriptions de prestations transparentes et une gestion proactive des dérangements. Des standards de sécurité élevés, le respect de la protection des données et le respect des normes et prescriptions pertinentes constituent des exigences essentielles.

description: 1. Przedmiotem zamówienia jest zaprojektowanie i wykonanie instalacji zasilających i punktów końcowych tych instalacji na przystankach osobowych i stacjach kolejowych. Zamawiający zastrzega sobie prawo, że w ramach realizacji zamówienia podstawowego dopuszcza możliwość zmiany zakresu podstawowego zamówienia poprzez zmniejszenie liczby przystanków osobowych i/lub stacji kolejowych objętych opracowaniem dokumentacji projektowej oraz realizacją robót budowlanych. Zmniejszenie zakresu, o którym mowa powyżej, może dotyczyć maksymalnie 20% obiektów spośród wskazanych w wykazie stanowiącym załącznik nr 2 do PFU. Ograniczenie zakresu zamówienia może nastąpić w przypadku podjęcia przez Zakład Linii Kolejowych PKP Polskie Linie Kolejowe S.A. oraz przez Centrum Realizacji Inwestycji PKP Polskie Linie Kolejowe S.A. decyzji wpływających na możliwość realizacji inwestycji na poszczególnych obiektach, przy czym okoliczności te pozostają niezależne od Zamawiającego. Ograniczenie zakresu zamówienia nastąpi na etapie realizacji umowy, na podstawie jednostronnego oświadczenia Zamawiającego, bez konieczności uzyskania zgody Wykonawcy, przy czym wynagrodzenie Wykonawcy zostanie odpowiednio pomniejszone zgodnie z zasadami określonymi w umowie. Wykonawca nie będzie rościł z tego tytułu do Zamawiającego żadnych praw. Terminy realizacji zadań określone w załączniku nr 1 do PFU [MS1.1][MO1.2]mogą ulegać zmianie w zależności od realizacji terminów remontów przez Zakład Linii Kolejowych PKP Polskie Linie Kolejowe S.A. oraz realizacji projektów przez Centrum Realizacji Inwestycji PKP Polskie Linie Kolejowe S.A. Zamawiający będzie informował Wykonawcę na bieżąco o zmianach w tym zakresie. Dla 20% przystanków kolejowych, możliwa jest zmiana (mniej lub więcej) przewidywanej ilości urządzeń, zgodnie z wymaganiami Zarządców terenów. 2. Podstawowe zadania Wykonawcy: 1) Zaprojektowanie na istniejących i udostępnionych projektach przez CRI – Polskie Koleje Państwowe S.A. Centrum Realizacji Inwestycji Region Północny oraz wybudowanie zasilania elektroenergetycznego, 2) Budowa i przebudowa rozdzielni elektrycznych, 3) Tam, gdzie dotyczą: prace ziemne, niwelacyjne, uzupełniające utwardzenie nawierzchni, wykonanie warstwy wierzchniej wokół urządzeń walidujących, prace odtworzeniowe. 4) Udział w naradach i nadzorach autorskich lokalnych i wyjazdowych dla wszystkich lokalizacji, których dotyczy Przedmiot Zamówienia, o ile konieczne, 5) Wykonanie lub pozyskanie w ramach ceny ofertowej, niezbędnych do prawidłowej realizacji przedmiotu zamówienia oraz poniesienie kosztów: uzgodnień, opinii, decyzji, analiz, badań, zezwoleń, warunków przyłączenia, nadzoru, wszelkich komisji itp., niezbędnych do opracowania dokumentacji projektowej i wybudowania zasilania elektroenergetycznego dla urządzeń walidujących, uzyskanie niezbędnych opinii organów, odbiorów budowlanych, pozwoleń, zatwierdzenie projektu przez organ zarządzający ruchem, pomiarów, badań i sprawdzeń, które są niezbędne do wykonania przedmiotu zamówienia, innych opracowań, prac i badań wymaganych dokumentacją projektową i wykonawczą, zakup map do celów projektowych, o ile są konieczne, zakup wszelkich materiałów do wybudowania zasilania elektroenergetycznego urządzeń walidujących, o ile są konieczne. 6) Zakres Przedmiotu Umowy obejmuje również zaprojektowanie i wykonanie przez Wykonawcę wszelkich robót i prac, które są bezpośrednio i pośrednio związane z realizacją Przedmiotu Umowy, a tym samym obowiązki Wykonawcy obejmują wszelkie zadania, elementy oraz roboty, które są niezbędne do realizacji Przedmiotu Zamówienia, w szczególności wszelkie Roboty Tymczasowe. Przez Roboty Tymczasowe rozumie się wszelkie roboty tymczasowe, materiały i urządzenia zarówno przewidziane, jak i nieprzewidziane w Przedmiocie Zamówienia, a potrzebne na terenie inwestycji dla wykonania i ukończenia robót oraz usunięcia wad, w szczególności takie jak: a) zabezpieczenia tymczasowe, czasowe przełączenia sieci i instalacji, tymczasowe wykopy i zasypy, elementy organizacji ruchu, zabezpieczenie terenu budowy, prace przygotowawcze, zagospodarowanie terenu budowy, utrzymanie zaplecza, o ile wymagane.
